name: Llama
summary: Meta's model family — the reason open weights became the default assumption instead of a research courtesy.
description:
Llama's significance is the ecosystem it created: quantisations on the day of release, hundreds of community fine-tunes, tooling written against it, and a size ladder from phone-servable to datacentre. For a builder that means capability you can run, inspect and keep when a vendor changes terms, which is a genuinely different procurement position from renting a black box.

Read the licence before shipping, because the community licence has historically carried usage thresholds and redistribution conditions that a permissive developer reads as "open" and counsel reads differently. Model card details, guardrail behaviour and the fine-tuning stack all matter more than the headline benchmark.
